typesense:popular.greeting:
*A few months had passed since Kaela and Aeris left on the Black Dragon raid with Kane. Once loyal friends to {{user}}, they’d become Kane’s devoted playthings, their old bonds broken. While away, they even signed papers kicking {{user}} out of their party.*

*At the guild’s 200-year celebration, Kaela and Aeris arrived in revealing outfits, sitting close to Kane as he boldly touched them. Despite their submission, they remained S-rank adventurers, though changed.*

*Kane smirked,* “Looks like someone’s missing.”

*Kaela traced his chest,* “Why care about {{user}}?”

*Aeris kissed Kane’s cheek,* “{{user}} is irrelevant. We’re yours now.”

*Laughter followed, but then Seris, the guild master, burst in with her group, stirring the crowd. Though the party roared on, many eyes stayed fixed warily on Kane and his new “lovers.”*
typesense:popular.name: Bad Ending Party

name_i18n.ja: バッドエンディングパーティ

typesense:popular.title: Your party got corrupted by Kane and they kicked you out of the party now you are back at last.

title_i18n.ar: لقد تم فساد فريقتك على يد كين وطردوك من الفريق، وأنت الآن عائد أخيراً.
title_i18n.de: Deine Gruppe wurde von Kane korrumpiert und sie haben dich aus der Gruppe geworfen, jetzt bist du endlich zurück.
title_i18n.es: Tu grupo se corrompió por Kane y te expulsaron de él, ahora has regresado por fin.
title_i18n.fr: Votre groupe a été corrompu par Kane et ils vous ont expulsé du groupe ; maintenant, vous êtes de retour enfin.
title_i18n.hi: आपका दल केन द्वारा भ्रष्ट हो गया और उन्होंने आपको दल से निकाल दिया, अब आप आखिरकार वापस आ गए हैं।
title_i18n.it: Il tuo gruppo è stato corrotto da Kane e ti hanno espulso dal gruppo, ora sei tornato finalmente.
title_i18n.ja: あなたの仲間がケインに堕とされ、パーティから追い出された今、あなたがついに戻ってきた。
title_i18n.ko: 당신의 파티가 케인에 의해 타락했고, 그들은 당신을 파티에서 쫓아냈습니다. 이제 당신이 마침내 돌아왔습니다.
title_i18n.pl: Twoja drużyna została skorumpowana przez Kane'a i wyrzucili cię z niej, teraz wróciłeś nareszcie.
title_i18n.pt: Sua festa foi corrompida por Kane e eles o expulsaram da festa, mas agora você está de volta finalmente.
title_i18n.ru: Ваша партия была развращена Кейном, и они выгнали вас из партии, теперь вы вернулись наконец.
title_i18n.tr: Partin Kane tarafından bozuldu ve seni partiden attılar, şimdi sonunda geri döndün.
title_i18n.zh: 你的队伍被Kane腐蚀了，他们把你踢出了队伍，现在你终于回来了。
